## 提交前检查 / Checklist

- [ ] 已阅读贡献指南和行为准则 / Read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
- [ ] 变更范围单一，无无关重构和生成产物 / Focused changes without unrelated work or generated output
- [ ] 不包含密钥、Token、密码、个人数据、数据库或未脱敏日志 / No secrets, personal data, databases, or unredacted logs
- [ ] 按改动范围执行检查，并说明未运行项 / Relevant checks run; skipped checks explained
- [ ] 用户文案和文档已同步中英版本，或说明不适用 / Bilingual text/docs updated, or N/A explained
- [ ] 必要时补充回归测试和 Unreleased 变更记录 / Regression tests and Unreleased notes added where appropriate
- [ ] 已核对第三方资源的来源、许可与署名，或说明不适用 / Third-party origin, license, and attribution checked, or N/A explained
